properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 5 at 10:52AM EDT until September 5 at 11:15AM EDT by NWS Charleston WV
properties.description:
At 1052 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from near Argo to near Davenport to 7 miles northeast of
Wise, moving southeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Grundy, Davenport, Trammel, Bradshaw, Stacy, Nora, Vansant, Hurley,
Jolo, Oakwood, and Roseann.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with these storms, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 5 at 10:56AM EDT until September 5 at 11:15AM EDT by NWS Morristown TN
properties.description:
At 1055 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 12 miles southeast of Wise to 6 miles east of
Sneedville, moving southeast at 55 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Norton, Wise, Jonesville, Big Stone Gap, Pennington Gap, Coeburn,
Appalachia, St. Paul, Nickelsville, and Dungannon.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Wind damage with these storms will occur before any rain or
lightning. Do not wait for the sound of thunder before taking cover.
SEEK SHELTER IMMEDIATELY inside a sturdy structure and stay away from
windows.

Continuous cloud to ground lightning is occurring with these storms.
Move indoors immediately. Lightning is one of nature's leading
killers. Remember, if you can hear thunder, you are close enough to
be struck by lightning.

properties.areaDesc: Champaign, OH; Logan, OH; Union, OH
properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 5 at 9:12AM EDT until September 5 at 12:15PM EDT by NWS Wilmington OH
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Central Logan County in west central Ohio...

* WHEN...Until 1215 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 909 AM EDT, local law enforcement reported flooding in the
warned area.  Between 3 and 4.5 inches of rain have fallen.
Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.5 inches are possible.
- Some locations that may experience flooding include...
Bellefontaine, West Liberty, Russells Point, Lakeview,
Huntsville, Valley Hi, Zanesfield, Mcmorran, New Jerusalem,
Pickrelltown, Lewistown, East Liberty and Middleburg.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

To report flooding, go to our website at weather.gov/iln and submit
your report via social media, when you can do so safely.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 5 at 9:50AM CDT until September 5 at 10:15AM CDT by NWS Bismarck ND
properties.description:
At 950 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 6 miles north of
Barton, or 18 miles northwest of Rugby, moving southeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Ping pong ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect wind
damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Willow City, Barton, Barton City, Overly and Omemee.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.description:
SVRRNK

The National Weather Service in BLACKSBURG has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Smyth County in southwestern Virginia...
Southwestern Tazewell County in southwestern Virginia...

* Until 1145 AM EDT.

* At 1049 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 9 miles northwest of War to near Davenport to near
Norton, moving southeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Marion...
Richlands...
Saltville...
Chilhowie...
Cedar Bluff...
Nebo...
and Raven.
properties.instruction:
Prepare immediately for damaging winds. For your safety, move to an
interior room on the lowest floor of a sturdy building. Stay away
from windows.

Locally heavy rain will quickly reduce visibility and result in
ponding of water on roadways, standing water in low lying areas, and
minor flooding of creeks, streams, and areas of poor drainage.
Drivers are urged to slow down and use extra caution to avoid
hydroplaning.

When it is safe to do so, please send your reports of hail of any
size, as well as reports of any wind damage, including downed trees
or large limbs, to the National Weather Service by calling toll free
at 1...8 6 6...2 1 5...4 3 2 4. Reports and pictures can also be
shared on the National Weather Service Blacksburg Facebook page and
on X.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 4 at 8:09PM CDT until September 6 at 10:36AM CDT by NWS Lake Charles LA
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Neches River at Neches River Saltwater Barrier affecting Jefferson,
Hardin, Jasper and Orange Counties.

Village Creek Near Kountze affecting Hardin County.

...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in Texas...

Pine Island Bayou Near Sour Lake affecting Jefferson and Hardin
Counties.

For the Neches River...including Town Bluff, Evadale, Neches River
Saltwater Barrier...Minor flooding is forecast.
For the Village Creek...including Kountze...Moderate flooding is
forecast.
For the Pine Island Bayou...including Sour Lake...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Moderate flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...Village Creek near Kountze.

* WHEN...Until Sunday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 21.9 feet, At this level, water will be flowing over
the Highway 418 bridge.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:30 PM CDT Friday the stage was 21.9 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 12.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 7:30 PM CDT Friday was 22.4 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage late
tomorrow evening and continue falling to 5.9 feet Wednesday
evening.
- Flood stage is 17.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 21.8
feet on 02/12/1966.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Saturday morning at 815 AM CDT.
